_comment_domain: Canonical brand URL. Run enable-domain.ps1 for live HTTPS (Cloudflare tunnel or Tailscale Funnel).
_comment_tailscale: Server binds 0.0.0.0 — reachable via LAN and Tailscale (100.x.x.x). Open http://<tailscale-ip>:3000 from any device in your tailnet. Windows may need an inbound firewall rule on this port for the Tailscale adapter.
